title: Analyze PDF files with Gemini

body.text: Gemini supports uploading PDF files and
can read the whole document and answer questions right away
— great for summarizing reports, contracts, or long academic documents.

example: "[Attach an annual report PDF] Summarize the key points and main figures."

title: What is Document Q&A?

body.text: asking specific questions about a document's contents
— like finding information in a contract without reading all of it, or comparing data across different pages.

example: "[Attach an employment contract PDF] What are the vacation-leave terms in this contract?"

question: What can Gemini do with a PDF file?

options.text: Edit and save a new PDF
Read, summarize, and answer questions from the PDF's content
Convert the PDF to a Word file

question: What's the benefit of Document Q&A?

options.text: It helps you find information in a document without reading all of it
It creates new documents from templates

question: Which is the most appropriate example of using Gemini with a PDF?

options.text: Attaching a 50-page report and asking 'What are the key points?'

question: You have a 30-page PDF manual and want to ask only about topics you care about. What should you do?

options.text: Upload the PDF and ask specific questions (Document Q&A)

question: What kind of work is Document Q&A good for?

options.text: Quickly finding answers in long documents
